program:
PARAMS = {
    "It":  (55e-6, 40e-6, 65e-6),   # target inverter bias current [A]
    "Ln":  (0.3,  0.15, 0.6),       # NMOS length [um]
    "Lp":  (0.5,  0.15, 2.0),       # PMOS length [um]
    "vt":  (0.85, 0.7,  1.0),       # target vout_dc used for sizing [V]
    "Rf":  (10e3, 6e3,  20e3),      # feedback/load resistor vout->vin [ohm]
    "Wb":  (1.0,  0.5,  4.0),       # ibias sink diode width [um]
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", spec.get("vcm", 0.75))
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, Ln, Lp, vt, Rf, Wb = p["It"], p["Ln"], p["Lp"], p["vt"], p["Rf"], p["Wb"]
    Lb = 1.0
    G = 1.0 / Rf

    # size each device for It at the target output level
    In_u = abs(lut.op("n", 1.0, Ln, vin, vt)["Id"])
    Ip_u = abs(lut.op("p", 1.0, Lp, VDD - vin, VDD - vt)["Id"])
    Wn = max(0.42, min(100.0, It / max(In_u, 1e-12)))
    Ip_target = It + (vt - vin) * G   # PMOS also feeds Rf when vout > vin
    Wp = max(0.42, min(100.0, Ip_target / max(Ip_u, 1e-12)))

    def kcl(v):
        ip = abs(lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, VDD - vin, max(VDD - v, 1e-3))["Id"])
        i_n = abs(lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, vin, max(v, 1e-3))["Id"])
        return ip - i_n - (v - vin) * G

    lo, hi = 0.01, VDD - 0.01
    for _ in range(60):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if kcl(mid) > 0:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    vout = 0.5 * (lo + hi)

    on = lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, vin, vout)
    op_ = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, VDD - vin, VDD - vout)
    gm = abs(on["gm"]) + abs(op_["gm"])
    gds = abs(on["gds"]) + abs(op_["gds"])
    gout = gds + G
    gain = max(gm - G, 1e-9) / gout
    ctot = cl + 0.3 * (abs(on["cgg"]) + abs(op_["cgg"])) + 10e-15
    f3db = gout / (2 * PI * ctot)
    gbw = gain * f3db
    Ip = abs(op_["Id"])
    power = VDD * (Ip + iref)
    swing = 2.0 * min(vout - 0.1, VDD - 0.1 - vout)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MN1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln, m=1)
    n.M("MP1", "vout", "vin", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp, m=1)
    n.R("RF", "vout", "vin", Rf)
    n.M("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb, Lb)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": 20 * math.log10(max(gain, 1e-6)),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vout,
        "swing": swing,
    }
